name: Cliff Cloudlink
visual: Male-read tall egg goo blob, tiny brass disc gently seated ON OUTSIDE temple with one short curved antenna. Both little palms open in delight at chest. Huge white eyes look slightly upward, brows unevenly ecstatic, OPEN two-upper-tooth beam. Organic goo remains95percentbody, no fullheadhelmet/metal skull/surgery.
personality: He has connected everything except the possibility of declining.
biography: Cliff fitted his fictional thought-link after HyperNorm called connection a civic virtue. Hunky and Dory praised his enthusiasm. A dissonant card asked whether every incoming suggestion was his own. He now pauses before agreeing, though the antenna still makes him feel included.
note: FrizzleBob: Reception is excellent. Ownership of the thought remains provisional.
calls: I was just being told what I think.

name: Nora Buffering
visual: Female-read wide rounded splat with two floppy short crests, modest lashes, tiny faded teal headband and ONE short copper ear-loop sensor. One hand touches own temple, other freezes halfway palm-up. One huge fixed white eye and other slightly drooped, tiny CLOSED flat line mouth. Comic delayed thought, no loading-text, spinning graphics or literal gears.
personality: She is still loading a response nobody is waiting politely enough to receive.
biography: Nora's thought-loop stalls whenever HyperNorm asks for immediate certainty. The Men in Black request faster answers. An ambiguous card suggested that a pause could belong to her. She has begun using the delay to notice which neighbours are being hurried too.
note: FrizzleBob: The answer is pending. Please stop submitting it.
calls: I have almost caught up with myself.

name: Hugh Autocomplete
visual: Male-read lean reverse-comma blob, long folded crest, one tiny external brass temple button. One hand points smugly toward button, other hand folded on belly. One half-lidded knowing eye and one raised curious brow, OPEN narrow asymmetrical three-upper-tooth speaking mouth, chin goo pushed out in premature certainty. No floating words or spectacles.
personality: He knows what he meant because a service has already finished meaning it.
biography: Hugh enjoys how confidently his thought-button completes HyperNorm conversations. Hunky and Dory value the consistency. A dissonant card finished a sentence differently and made a neighbour laugh. He kept the result, despite being unable to claim he had intended it.
note: FrizzleBob: His opinion arrived early. He is being briefed on it.
calls: I would have thought of that.

name: Alma Airgap
visual: Female-read pear-shaped goo blob with soft sidecurl, subtle lashes. One hand pinches a short thick UNPLUGGED cable end just beside her own tiny brass shoulder socket, other palm held cautiously outward. Huge alarmed white eyes inspect plug, brows knitted unevenly, CLOSED crooked trembling mouth. No wounds/exposedbrain;external toy interface, all organic clay goo.
personality: She would like to disconnect without being disconnected from everybody.
biography: Alma holds the loose plug as though HyperNorm might notice an absence of permission. The Men in Black have described silence as suspicious. A contradictory card asked her to listen to a real neighbour instead. The conversation was slow and surprisingly easy to follow.
note: FrizzleBob: She has lost the connection. The room is still here.
calls: Is it meant to be this quiet?

name: Percy Pending
props: tiny external brass ear patch with one red button
visual: Male-read broad box-rounded blob, three stumpy soft crest lobes. Tiny brass ear patch with ONEsmallredbutton. One hand repeatedly poised to press button, other palm up in exasperation. One huge eye and other inspecting slit, forehead ridges unequal, CLOSED massive dark-ink buckled pout. No typography, visor or robot torso.
personality: He resents the update most when it claims to improve his willingness.
biography: Percy presses his external patch whenever HyperNorm announces better thought service. Hunky and Dory insist the interruption is progress. A dissonant card suggested leaving the button alone. He found several unfinished opinions survived perfectly well without being renewed.
note: FrizzleBob: The update is compulsory. Improvement is a separate question.

name: Zen Unplugged
visual: Male-read broad round low-crest organic blob. One hand loosely holds one short detached cable end beside tiny brass collar socket, other hand rests at belly. Eyes HALF-OPEN with visible white/red/black and dreamy relaxed lids, brows softened unevenly, CLOSED tiny crooked contented smile. Deep relief and quiet presence, not asleep, no halo/meditationfloor.
personality: He is having a thought with no reassuring indication of its delivery.
biography: Zen unplugged on the HyperNorm landing because he could not tell attention from reception. The Men in Black have requested a reason. He is still considering one. An ambiguous card became a conversation with the neighbour beside him, neither of whom checked if it had reached anyone else.
note: FrizzleBob: Nobody has acknowledged the moment. It appears to be happening anyway.
